capture-start.measurement: output plus input relative A/V; uncalibrated input
limitations: Periodic 1 Hz pattern: nearest pairing assumes offset within 400 ms; larger offsets are ambiguous.
Browser visual onset is frame-quantised; this does not establish sub-frame source synchrony.
Input A/V offset requires a known scheduled reference; no input correction applied.
Shared-device loopback does not test drift between independent devices.

capture-end.measurement: output plus input relative A/V; uncalibrated input
limitations: Periodic 1 Hz pattern: nearest pairing assumes offset within 400 ms; larger offsets are ambiguous.
Browser visual onset is frame-quantised; this does not establish sub-frame source synchrony.
Input A/V offset requires a known scheduled reference; no input correction applied.
Shared-device loopback does not test drift between independent devices.

interpretation: Gradual scheduled phase movement matches physical endpoints; source phase changes much less. Rate correction near -0.84 ppm and changing video selection age support frame-grid phase walk as a hypothesis, not proof of uncontrolled audio drift. No continuous physical capture or content-PTS per-frame trace; do not extrapolate indefinite linear drift.
method: analyze_pipeline_sync.analyse on explicit elapsed windows above; least-squares of hourly median scheduled A/V versus hour. Snapshots may omit events. Positive A/V means audio late.
